title: Lattice of Teeth
description: A dark, half-time IDM machine where a slow OberheimDMX kick anchors a perpetually mutating square-wave arpeggio and a swarm of ratcheting, glitch-degraded hats. Nothing drops; everything keeps shifting register, density and detune across the whole arc, drill-tinged and bone-dry.
code:
setcpm(88/4)
arrange(
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0),
    s("hh*8").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.42).degradeBy(0.5).pan(perlin.range(0.3,0.7)).cut(1),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.42).lpf(900)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0),
    s("hh*16").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.4).degradeBy(perlin.range(0.3,0.6)).ply("<1 1 2 1>").cut(1).pan(rand),
    s("~ ~ rim ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).sometimesBy(0.3, x=>x.ply(2)),
    n("0 2 4 7 4 2".add("<0 0 3 -2>")).scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.46).lpf(1200).hpf(120)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0),
    s("bd*2").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).degradeBy(0.7).off(0.06,x=>x.gain(0.3)),
    s("hh*16").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.4).degradeBy(perlin.slow(8).range(0.25,0.6)).ply("<1 2 1 4>").cut(1).pan(rand),
    s("sh ~ sh sh ~ sh ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.34).sometimesBy(0.4, x=>x.fast(2)),
    n("<0 -2 3 5>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.18).sustain(0.1).gain(0.5).lpf(perlin.slow(16).range(300,1100)),
    n("0 2 4 7 9 7 4 2".add("<0 3 -2 5>")).scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.44).lpf(1600).hpf(200).pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.35,0.65))

  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0),
    s("[hh hh]*8").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.4).degradeBy(0.35).ply("<2 4 1 8>").cut(1).pan(perlin.range(0.2,0.8)),
    s("cp(3,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.42).sometimesBy(0.25,x=>x.speed(1.5)),
    n("0 7 12 7 4 9 4 2".add("<0 -2 3 -4>")).scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.09).sustain(0).gain(0.46).lpf(2000).hpf(250).sometimesBy(0.2,x=>x.add(note(12))),
    n("<0 3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.2).sustain(0.15).gain(0.5).lpf(700)
  )],
  [14, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.95),
    s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.4).degradeBy(0.3),
    n("0 3 7 10 7 3").scale("C4:minor").s("triangle").attack(0.02).decay(0.4).sustain(0.2).release(0.3).gain(0.5).lpf(perlin.slow(12).range(500,1800)).pan(sine.slow(5).range(0.3,0.7)),
    n("<0 -4>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.46).lpf(600)
  )],
  [22, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0),
    s("bd*2").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).degradeBy(0.6),
    s("hh*16").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.42).degradeBy(perlin.slow(8).range(0.2,0.55)).ply("<2 4 8 4>").cut(1).pan(rand),
    s("sh*8").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.3).degradeBy(0.5).sometimesBy(0.3,x=>x.ply(2)),
    s("~ cp ~ ~ ~ ~ cp ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.42).off(0.04,x=>x.gain(0.25)),
    n("0 2 4 7 9 12 9 7 4 2".add("<0 3 -2 5 7>")).scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.08).sustain(0).gain(0.46).lpf(perlin.slow(11).range(1200,2800)).hpf(220).pan(sine.slow(6).range(0.3,0.7)).sometimesBy(0.25,x=>x.add(note(12))),
    n("<0 -2 3 5 -4 7>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).gain(0.5).lpf(perlin.slow(20).range(350,1300)),

    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0),
    s("hh*8").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.4).degradeBy(0.5).cut(1).pan(perlin.range(0.3,0.7)),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.42).lpf(perlin.slow(10).range(400,900))
  )]
)
